description: Hand-authored responses of the injected replacement boundary (applyReplacement) for fix tests. Each entry names the exact request the preparer must send (source text by commit/path, the SARIF deletedRegion as given, literal inserted text, the run's columnKind) and the response a correct replacement module gives, using its outcome kinds (replacement, invalid, unsupported, unanchored). editedText is authored as lines. originalText/replacementText keep full selected-line terminators; replacementText '' means zero replacement lines. Integration tests separately run the real module and must reach the same expected reviews.
